What is Squash?

Squash is a sport in which there is a requirement for Squash Rackets, Squash Balls, Squash Strings, and accessories. This game is played by either two players or four players. In other words, either a singles squash game or a doubles squash game. This sport is played on a four-walled squash court with small squash rubber balls. The main goal of squash sport is to hit the squash ball against an opposing team in such a way that they are unable to hit the returning squash ball toward the first one.

Squash players back up in hitting the squash ball with their squash rackets onto the four-wallet squash court. It is recommended to squash players, first-time squash racket buyers, or buyers to buy the squash racket which suits best to your playing technique, level, or style. Squash rackets (similar to tennis rackets) are light in weight & offer a perfect balance & comfort to squash players.I'm the squash coach also.
